title: Маятниковая миграция в Московском регионе: новые данные
method: DIT Moscow anonymized big-three operator data, aggregated home-work matrix, 500m cells; aggregated temporal and municipal reports; no raw subscriber data acquired
published_complete_municipal_share_map: Figure7, PDFp13; five class bands and explicit denominator; original bytes acquired
data_not_interchangeable: Rail2014 passengers include repeated travel and nonwork purposes; cannot substitute for mobile2015 worker shares
independence: These published observations were inspected during development; they are external evidence, not a blinded holdout
scope: Municipal context, no causal interpretation and no forced assignment of Word type or NP commuting flags
